apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: jaide-v35-deployment
  namespace: jaide
  labels:
    app: jaide-v35
spec:
  replicas: 256
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: jaide-v35
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: jaide-v35
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - weight: 100
            podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchExpressions:
                - key: app
                  operator: In
                  values:
                  - jaide-v35
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
        nodeAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            nodeSelectorTerms:
            - matchExpressions:
              - key: nvidia.com/gpu
                operator: Exists
      tolerations:
      - key: nvidia.com/gpu
        operator: Exists
        effect: NoSchedule
      containers:
      - name: jaide-core
        image: jaide-v35:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
          name: http
          protocol: TCP
        - containerPort: 50051
          name: grpc
          protocol: TCP
        - containerPort: 10001
          name: ray
          protocol: TCP
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "64"
            memory: "2048Gi"
            nvidia.com/gpu: "8"
          requests:
            cpu: "32"
            memory: "1024Gi"
            nvidia.com/gpu: "4"
        env:
        - name: JAIDE_CONFIG
          value: "/app/config.json"
        - name: RAY_HEAD
          value: "ray://ray-head:10001"
        - name: IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: quantum-secrets
              key: ibm_token
        - name: IONQ_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: quantum-secrets
              key: ionq_key
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config-vol
          mountPath: /app/config
          readOnly: true
        - name: models-vol
          mountPath: /app/models
        - name: proofs-vol
          mountPath: /app/proofs
          readOnly: true
        - name: bitstream-vol
          mountPath: /app/bitstreams
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            exec:
              command: ["/app/pre_stop.sh"]
      - name: ray-head
        image: rayproject/ray:latest
        command: ["ray", "start", "--head", "--port=6379", "--node-manager-port=10001"]
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "4"
            memory: "8Gi"
          requests:
            cpu: "2"
            memory: "4Gi"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ray-data
          mountPath: /ray
      - name: zkp-verifier
        image: circom/verifier:latest
        command: ["zk-verifier", "/app/proofs/computation_proof_final.zkey"]
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "2"
            memory: "4Gi"
          requests:
            cpu: "1"
            memory: "2Gi"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: proofs-vol
          mountPath: /app/proofs
      initContainers:
      - name: fpga-load
        image: xc7a100t-fpga-loader:latest
        command: ["load-bitstream", "/app/bitstreams/jaide_fpga.bit"]
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "1"
            memory: "1Gi"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: bitstream-vol
          mountPath: /app/bitstreams
      volumes:
      - name: config-vol
        configMap:
          name: jaide-config
      - name: models-vol
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: jaide-models-pvc
      - name: proofs-vol
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: jaide-proofs-pvc
      - name: bitstream-vol
        hostPath:
          path: /dev/xilinx-fpga0
      - name: ray-data
        emptyDir: {}
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 25%
      maxSurge: 25%

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: jaide-v35-service
  namespace: jaide
spec:
  selector:
    app: jaide-v35
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
  - name: grpc
    port: 50051
    targetPort: 50051
    protocol: TCP
  - name: ray
    port: 10001
    targetPort: 10001
    protocol: TCP
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: jaide-config
  namespace: jaide
data:
  config.json: |-
    {
      "model": {
        "dim": 18432,
        "layers": 768,
        "seq_len": 128000
      }
    }
  pre_stop.sh: |-
    #!/bin/bash
    ray stop
    sleep 5

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: jaide-models-pvc
  namespace: jaide
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Ti
  storageClassName: fast-ssd

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: jaide-proofs-pvc
  namespace: jaide
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadOnlyMany
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Ti
  storageClassName: standard

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: quantum-secrets
  namespace: jaide
type: Opaque
data:
  ibm_token: <base64-encoded-token>
  ionq_key: <base64-encoded-key>

---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: jaide-ingress
  namespace: jaide
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
spec:
  rules:
  - host: jaide-v35.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: jaide-v35-service
            port:
              number: 80
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - jaide-v35.example.com
    secretName: jaide-tls

# End of deployment.yaml
